主要内容: NOVAVAX INC and Cadila Pharmaceuticals Ltd., a company incorporated under the laws of India, entered into a Second Amended and Restated Joint Venture Agreement for CPL Biologicals Private Limited. CPLB concurrently entered into Second Amended and Restated Product License Agreements with both the Company and Cadila as parts of the Amended Joint Venture Agreement. The Agreements permit CPLB to develop and commercialize certain Cadila biological products and to develop certain products using Novavax’ nanoparticle vaccine production, antigen specific seed development, protein expression, and cloning system technology. NOVAVAX INC and CPLB have clarified their rights of first negotiation regarding products developed or commercialized using each other's technology. The agreements also outline the initial development of four vaccine candidate seeds by NOVAVAX on behalf of CPLB. Ownership rights and percentages remain unchanged. The agreements are referenced in the Company’s 10-Q filing for the quarter ending September 30, 2018.
